_notes: 시내면세점 구매품은 출국 인도장에서만 수령(신라 FAQ). 신라 온라인 미수령 10일 취소(신라 e스토어). 신라 고객센터 1688-1110(신라 공식). 롯데 번호는 미확인 → 영수증 안내.

en.title: Jeju Duty Free Lost Items & Uncollected Purchases (Lotte, Shilla, Airport Pickup)
en.desc: Left a bag in a Jeju duty-free store, or missed collecting your duty-free order at the airport? Who to contact and what happens to uncollected goods.
en.h1: Lost Items and Uncollected Purchases at Jeju Duty Free
summary: Left something inside a downtown duty-free store (Lotte, Shilla)? Contact that store's information desk or customer center — the number is on your receipt.
Didn't collect your purchase at the airport pickup counter? Contact the store you bought from right away; uncollected orders can be cancelled after a deadline.
Goods bought at downtown duty-free stores can only be handed over at the departure pickup counter — not delivered to your home.

sections.body:
Shopping bags, phones and passports left at a counter are usually kept by the store's information desk first. Call the store with the time, floor or brand counter, and a description. The customer center number is printed on your receipt and on the store's website (The Shilla Duty Free: 1688-1110).

Items that stay unclaimed may later be handed to the police and appear in the police lost-property database.

Downtown duty-free purchases are handed over only at the departure pickup counter on the day you leave, after checking your passport and flight. If you missed it:

  • Contact the store's customer center as soon as possible with your receipt or order number.
  • Ask whether the order can be moved to a later departure or must be refunded. For example, The Shilla Duty Free says unclaimed online orders may be cancelled 10 days after the original departure date.
  • Check that your passport number matches the order — a mismatch can stop the handover.

sections.h: Left purchases behind after the pickup counter
sections.body: If you collected your goods and then left the bag in the departure area or on the plane, it's no longer the store's responsibility. Contact Jeju Airport Lost & Found (terminal) or your airline (on board).

faq.q: Can the duty-free store send my uncollected purchase to China?
faq.a: Downtown duty-free purchases are generally handed over only at departure. Ask the store's customer center about a refund or a later pickup.

faq.q: I left my passport at a duty-free counter.
faq.a: Call the store immediately — passports are often kept at the information desk. If it isn't there, report the loss to the police and contact your consulate.
For items lost in a store, yes: we can contact the store in Korean, collect the item and send it to you. Uncollected duty-free purchases must be handled by the store itself.

zh.title: 济州免税店丢东西、没提到免税品怎么办（乐天、新罗、机场提货点）
zh.desc: 在济州市内免税店把购物袋落下了，或者在机场忘了提免税品？该联系谁、未提货的商品会怎么处理。
zh.h1: 济州免税店遗失物品和未提货商品
summary: 东西落在市内免税店（乐天、新罗）？联系该店的服务台或客服中心，电话印在购物小票上。
在机场提货点没提货？请马上联系购买的免税店，超过期限的未提货订单可能会被取消。
市内免税店购买的商品只能在出境提货点领取，不能寄到家里。

sections.body:
落在柜台的购物袋、手机、护照，一般先由免税店服务台保管。打电话时说明时间、楼层或品牌柜台以及物品特征。客服电话印在小票和官网上（新罗免税店：1688-1110）。

长期无人认领的物品之后可能会移交警察，可在警方失物数据库中查询。

市内免税店的商品只在出境当天、核对护照和航班后，在出境提货点交付。如果错过了：

  • 带上小票或订单号，尽快联系免税店客服中心。
  • 询问能否改到下次出境提货，还是只能退款。例如新罗免税店说明：网上订单自原出境日起10天未提货可能被取消。
  • 确认护照号码与订单一致——不一致会导致无法提货。

sections.h: 提货后又把东西落下了
sections.body: 如果已经提了货，又把袋子落在出境区或飞机上，就不归免税店管了。请联系济州机场失物招领处（航站楼内）或航空公司（飞机上）。

faq.q: 免税店能把没提的商品寄到中国吗？
faq.a: 市内免税店的商品一般只能在出境时交付。请向免税店客服咨询退款或下次提货。

faq.q: 护照落在免税店柜台了。
faq.a: 马上给免税店打电话，护照通常会交到服务台。如果没有，请报警并联系中国驻济州总领事馆。
落在店里的物品可以：我们用韩语联系免税店，取回后寄给你，可通过微信沟通。未提货的免税商品只能由免税店处理。
